text:
debrief db-021
1) The actor c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for the f-a-c-e s-c-a-n m-o-d-u-l-e using a c-a-m-e-r-a c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n d-r-i-v-e r-e-p-o-r-t and left a p-r-o-v-i-s-i-o-n a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-d-e-l-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-h-e-s-t-s
2) The actor r-o-u-t-e-d the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e through a m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e w-i-n-d-o-w using the s-y-s-t-e-m l-o-g g-r-o-u-p-i-n-g d-e-f-a-u-l-t-s and left a p-s-e-u-d-o n-a-m-e m-a-p-p-i-n-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-d-m-i-n r-e-v-i-e-w o-f f-l-a-g-s
3) The actor t-a-g-g-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s e-v-e-n-t-s as m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e using the b-u-i-l-t-i-n r-e-p-o-r-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e and left a s-t-a-m-p e-d-i-t l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-o-n-i-t-o-r-s-s-o-n s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g
4) The actor c-l-o-n-e-d the e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d p-e-r-s-o-n-s using the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e f-e-a-t-u-r-e and left a v-e-r-s-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n a-l-e-r-t-s
5) The actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the w-o-r-k-i-n-g f-i-l-e-s using the a-u-t-o c-l-e-a-n-u-p p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e and left a t-e-m-p-o-r-a-r-y d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l p-u-r-g-e c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n
